items.descZh: 这款产品是一款面向创作者和演出场景的现代化音乐可视化引擎，整合了五大渲染引擎与单一 HDR 管线，并搭配 12 段后处理链路（包含 LUT 色彩映射、God Rays 体积光、Bloom 辉光等），在视觉表现力上达到专业级。功能覆盖极广，既支持图片、视频、.milk、glsl、WebGPU、Three.js 等多种素材与着色器格式，也支持跨屏拼接（Span）、镜像、Wallpaper、Logos 等输出模式，同时兼容 OBS、Spout（输入/输出）、Ableton、NDI、游戏采集及工作流扩展，体现了高度的开放性与生态整合能力。亮点在于把传统 VJ 工具与实时 GPU 着色、跨平台音视频工作流融合到统一管道中，性能上以 12 pass 后处理和 HDR 管线保障高动态范围画面输出。适用场景涵盖音乐现场 VJ 演出、直播 OBS 推流、音乐制作可视化、Workshop 教学演示以及多屏装置艺术等。
items.quote: 五台引擎，一条 HDR 管线，搭配 12 遍后处理链。

[hrdx.dev](https://www.hrdx.dev) What is it? hrdx is a experimental, minimal and lightweight terminal multiplexer built for the agent era: your projects as workspaces in a sidebar, tabs per workspace, and real terminal panes running [Codex CLI](https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/codex/cli), [Claude Code](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/quickstart), [pi](https://www.pi.dev), [zot](https://www.zot.sh) or plain shells side by side. Kick off an agent in one project, switch to the next, and let the sidebar spinners tell you who is still working. Real terminals, not wrappers. Every pane is a genuine PTY session with a full terminal emulator behind it. Agent TUIs run exactly as they do standalone: streaming, slash commands, sessions, mouse support, all of it. Panes present a clean terminal identity so capabilitysniffing TUIs pick rendering paths that work inside a multiplexer, and HRDX=1 lets tools detect they run inside hrdx. Everything in view. The sidebar shows one hierarchy of workspaces, Git branches, and panes, adding tab rows only when a workspace has multiple tabs. Every pane has a shared status circle: agents become animated braille spinners while working, and an unfocused agent turns orange when it finishes. Focusing the pane acknowledges it and restores green. Feels like your terminal. Scrollback, mouse selection with clipboard copy, dragtoresize splits, dragtoreorder workspaces, rightclick context menus, and kitty keyboard protocol passthrough so even exotic chords like ctrl+1 reach your agent. Picks up where you left off. Quit and relaunch: shells and agents keep running in a lightweight session holder and reattach exactly where they were, running commands and all. Workspaces, tabs, splits, and ratios come back too, and if a session is truly gone, agents resume their latest conversation from their own session store. Yours to tune. A settings window (ctrl+b , or the gear in the sidebar) lets you switch individual agents on or off, pick a notification sound for finished turns (including your own audio files), and change the color theme, with user themes as simple JSON files. All persisted. See [Themes](themes). Bring your own agent. Register any agent CLI
items.author: patriceckhart
items.descZh: hrdx 是一款面向 AI 智能体时代打造的极简轻量级终端多路复用器，旨在解决开发者在同时管理多个 AI 编码代理（如 Codex CLI、Claude Code、pi、zot）时的痛点。其核心功能是以侧边栏工作区形式组织项目，每个工作区拥有独立标签页，并能并排运行真实的 PTY 终端面板，确保代理 TUI 的流式输出、斜杠命令、会话状态和鼠标支持与独立运行时完全一致。产品亮点包括：所有终端均为真实 PTY 会话而非包装器，配套 HRDX=1 环境变量以便工具识别运行环境；侧边栏通过统一的状态圆点呈现代理工作状态——运行中显示为动态盲文旋转器、完成未读时变橙、聚焦后恢复绿色；支持滚动回溯、鼠标选择与剪贴板复制、拖拽调整分屏与工作区顺序、kitty 键盘协议透传等贴近原生终端的交互；通过轻量级会话保持器实现退出后重新附加，分屏比例与工作区结构完整恢复；设置窗口支持按代理开关、个性化通知音效（含自定义音频文件）以及 JSON 主题配置。目前已积累 78 次提交，支持 Go 1.25+ 环境。适用场景方面，特别适合需要并行运行多个 AI 编码代理并实时监控其进度的开发者，以及追求 tmux/screen 替代方案但希望拥有更现代化代理感知界面的终端重度用户。
items.quote: 又一个为智能体时代打造的极简轻量级终端复用器。
items.titleZh: Show HN：又一个用Go语言编写的最小和轻量级的终端多路复用器。

Your team throws off a constant stream of activity — issues, merge requests, deploys, chatter — and keeping an eye on it means living in dashboards. State Media FM turns that activity into a lowkey internal radio station: calm focus music with the occasional spoken news bulletin, so you stay aware without staring at a screen. What. It's a small app you run on your own machine. It reads your team's tools (GitHub / GitLab, Hacker News, and more), writes short news updates, reads them aloud, and plays them over generative background music in a browser tab. It's free and opensource (Apache2.0), works offline, and phones nothing home. How. You run one command; it starts a local web server and opens a browser tab. You point it at your sources — and, optionally, an AI gateway for richer news writing — right in the Settings tab. No config files to edit, and everything you set is remembered next time. Run it You need Python 3.12+ and git. items.descZh: 这是一个将团队工作动态转化为"低强度内部电台"的开源工具，背景是开发者常需在多个仪表盘间切换以监控 CI/CD、合并请求和部署等事件。产品通过读取 GitHub、GitLab、Hacker News 等数据源，自动生成简短的新闻播报并以生成式背景音乐为陪衬，在浏览器标签页中持续播放，让用户无需紧盯屏幕即可保持对项目状态的感知。亮点包括：一条命令即可在本地启动 Web 服务器（默认端口 8150），完全离线运行、零数据外传、Apache 2.0 开源、设置自动记忆；项目已有 197 次提交，并附带 ENTRAINMENT、HARDENING_PLAN、SECURITY_MODEL 等完整技术文档体系，显示其对架构安全和零配置体验的重视。最适合需要长时间保持专注、又想被动接收团队动态的 DevOps 工程师、SRE 及远程协作团队成员，作为"环境音 + 偶尔语音简报"式的注意力辅助工具。

items.author: byte1
items.descZh:
文章介绍了FuckMark这一开源项目，旨在解决Google Chrome浏览器自2024年6月起停止支持Manifest V2扩展所导致的uBlock Origin等广告拦截工具失效问题。该项目通过修改uBlock Origin的Manifest V3声明文件，并将其打包为zip扩展，模拟为Chrome Web Store上架的扩展，从而绕过Chrome的安装限制。核心功能是让用户能够继续在Chrome上使用uBlock Origin的广告拦截能力，且安装过程通过开发者模式加载已解压的扩展程序完成，无需复杂操作。

亮点方面，作为临时过渡方案，FuckMark体积小巧且免去了完整项目构建的繁琐流程，用户只需几分钟即可重新启用广告拦截功能。鉴于官方uBO Lite虽支持MV3但功能受限，该项目有效弥补了Chrome浏览器在MV2弃用后用户体验的落差。

适用场景为Chrome用户，尤其是依赖uBlock Origin进行广告与恶意内容过滤的技术爱好者，但需注意此为非官方方案，存在被Chrome更新覆盖导致失效的风险，建议配合官方扩展或Firefox浏览器长期使用。
items.quote: 本项目打包了一个经过修改的 uBlock Origin 版本，将其清单（manifest）更新为 Manifest V3，并将其压缩，以便通过 Chr

items.title: Show HN: An Apple Passwords browser extension on Linux
items.desc: Goal was to use Apple Passwords from my Linux desktop (with a browser extension to autofill passwords). Combines existing public reverse engineering attempts. Also pulls TOTP codes from the keychain and HideMyEmail aliases from iCloud API. It also does NOT write new passwords back to iCloud (yet).
items.author: sank6
items.descZh: 该项目旨在让 Linux 桌面用户能够在浏览器中自动填充 Apple Passwords 密码，核心功能是通过浏览器扩展调用 iCloud API 来读取钥匙串中的密码，并额外支持提取 TOTP 动态验证码以及 iCloud HideMyEmail 随机邮箱别名。亮点在于整合了多个已有的逆向工程成果，在 Linux 环境下复现了 Apple 原生生态的密码管理体验，并明确表示目前仅支持单向读取，尚未实现将新密码写回 iCloud 的同步功能。适合 Linux 用户尤其是需要跨平台使用 Apple 密码体系、又离不开动态验证码和隐私邮箱功能的开发者或技术爱好者；但对于非 Apple 生态用户或仅需基础密码管理的用户而言，使用门槛偏高。
items.quote: 还拉TOTP代码从钥匙串和隐藏我的电子邮件别名从iCloud API.

[Vale](https://vale.sh) stylepackage that flags the tells of AIwritten and specgrade prose, so you can recast them in your own voice before you ship. Modern writing tools make it easy to produce text that reads like a machine wrote it. That prose has a fingerprint: the em dash, the epigram (is the hero, not a decoration), the antithesis flourish (reads as discipline, never confession), the virtue tag (done right), the abstractnoun triad (clarity, discipline, and trust). AiTells names each one where it appears, in Markdown, HTML, or plain text, entirely on your own machine. It does not rewrite for you. It marks the tell so you fix it yourself. Try it on your own prose, in one command You need: macOS or Linux · [Vale](https://vale.sh) (brew install vale) · python3 (ships with macOS). Under a minute, all of it on your machine. git clone https://github.com/krishnasunkam/valeaitells.git cd valeaitells && ./checkmyprose.sh ~/path/to/yourdoc.md ╭─ ✦ c h e c k m y p r o s e │ the tells of machinewritten text, found in yours ╰───────────────────────────────────── reading your prose… (it stays on this machine) 22 tells across 1 file — 6 mechanical (fix always), 16 judgment calls your fingerprint: · Adverb ×3 “quietly” · LinkText ×2 “This page” · Cliche ×2 “gamechanger” · Passive ×2 “was shipped” · …and 12 more rules fired most flagged: yourdoc.md (22 tells) verdict: reads machinedrafted — worth a real rewrite. your prose never left your machine. No arguments? It checks the markdown it finds nearby. The transcript above is a real run against examples/aiprose.md. Afterwards The clone is disposable: the fingerprint is the product. To make the rules part of a repo you own: mkdir p styles && cp R /path/to/valeaitells/AiTells styles/ Or skip the copy: point Vale straight at the release zip in your .vale.ini: StylesPath = styles Packages = https://github.com/krishnasunkam/valeaitells/releases/latest/download/AiTells.zip [.{md,markdown,txt}] BasedOnStyles = AiTells Then vale sync pulls the rules for you. If you copied the folder by hand instead, add the package to your .vale.ini: StylesPath = styles MinAlertLevel = suggestion [.{md,txt}] BasedOnStyles = AiTells Then sync and lint: vale sync vale yourdoc.md Use as a Claude Code skill Point Claude Code (or a compatible agent) at this repo and ask it to check your prose. [SKILL.md](/krishnasunkam/valeaitells/blob/main/SKILL.md) has the agent run the linter, read the findings back as a table, and offer recasts one at a time in your voice. items.author: krishnas2020
items.descZh: 背景：随着 LLM 普及，机写腔(em dash 滥用、对仗句、抽象名词三连等)成为技术写作的"指纹"问题，krishnasunkam 推出 valeaitells 工具专门识别并标记这些痕迹。核心功能：基于 Vale 风格检查器的开源包，通过 17 条规则扫描 Markdown、HTML 或纯文本中的 AI/规格化痕迹,将命中分为 6 条机械性错误(必须修)和 11 条主观判断项。亮点：完全本地运行(prot 与 prose 永不上传),在 examples/aiprose.md 实测中一次性检测出 22 处 tells(含 "quietly" 副词 ×3、"This page" 链接文本 ×2、"gamechanger" 陈词 ×2 等),并附 bench/、tests/ 评估套件与 checkmyprose.sh 一键脚本;另可作 Claude Code 技能逐条给出人工化改写建议。适用场景:技术博客作者、文档维护者、追求个人文风的工程师,以及需要把 Vale 直接接入 GitHub Actions/CI 流程的团队,以"规则底线"方式过滤机写味而非依赖黑盒检测器。
items.quote: 一个Vale风格包，标记了AI编写的和特殊的散文。一个规则层，而不是一个检测器。

items.title: Show HN: See fiber breaks linked to a map
items.desc: description: Interactive React components for network diagrams, fiber networks, and rack infrastructure visualization. title: React Networks Examples image: https://reactnetworkslib.rackout.net/networkdiagrampreview.png
items.author: matt-p
items.descZh: React Networks Examples 是一个面向网络基础设施可视化的交互式 React 组件库,专注于网络拓扑、光纤链路以及机柜设备的图形化展示。它将复杂的网络架构以可交互的 React 组件形式呈现,方便开发者直接集成到 Web 应用中。该库的核心亮点在于支持多种专业场景的细粒度可视化,包括逻辑网络拓扑图、地理化的光纤网络布局以及机房机柜(U 位空间)的三维或平面化展示,组件支持动态交互如节点拖拽、连线高亮及详情钻取,通常基于 SVG/Canvas 渲染保证性能。结合 React 的声明式特性,用户能够通过数据驱动快速构建从局域网到广域网、从设备到端口的完整可视化方案。典型适用场景包括 IDC 运维管理平台、企业网络监控大屏、光纤资源管理及可视化教学工具,尤其适合需要直观呈现设备、链路和机柜资源关系的 B 端产品。
items.quote: 用于网络拓扑、光纤网络和机柜基础设施可视化的交互式 React 组件。
